entries.zh: 阐（或闸，字有歧）；赞扬、申明
entries.en: to expound/praise (char. uncertain: 闡 'expound' vs 閘 'sluice gate')
entries.notes: 封存件标记 [疑:闡/閘]，L 栏 A. labar.（alabar 赞扬）缩写展开依赖推断，故降 medium。

entries.zh: 称呼；亦含赞许看重之意
entries.en: to call/address; to praise and hold in esteem
entries.notes: L 栏 alabar y tener en mucho 与 H 栏 称呼 语义不完全吻合（汉语取 称呼，西语取 赞许看重），两解并存，降 medium。

entries.en: to admire and envy with delight
to raise; to recommend/promote in praise

entries.zh: 衍（或衎，字有歧）；自夸、自得貌
entries.notes: 封存件标记 [疑:衍/衎] 且 L 栏 alabar se asi'nejmos（应为 assi mismos）识读不确，语义难以定夺。

entries.zh: 逞头皮；逞强露脸、厚脸皮炫耀
entries.en: to brazenly boast/show off (lit. show one's scalp/face)

entries.zh: 逞气；意气用事、逞一时之气
entries.en: to act on bravado/spite, showing off one's spirit
entries.notes: L 栏 se Podolipuede（疑为 si puede 之类识读残误）依赖推断，降 medium。

entries.zh: 逞豪傑；逞英雄、务求占上风
entries.en: to swagger as a hero; to insist on having one's way (salir con la suya)

entries.zh: 逞驕；骄傲自负、倨傲自夸
讨着就无；号称富有事后却一毛不拔（空口许诺不兑现）
entries.en: to boast of being rich and afterwards give nothing
to be praised and admired by all (commonly extolled)
entries.notes: L 栏 d'acierta 识读存疑，但 H/M/R 三栏 通称羡 互证一致，降 medium 保守处理。
